scope_notes: Fresh Action load timings include checkpoint reads, construction, loading normalization/weights, and strict legacy metadata audit; imports and filesystem caches are warm, so not true process/disk cold-start.
First full inference follows each of 30 independent Action loads. Steady inference follows one explicit warmup per arm.

Full predict includes measurement validation, moment provider where present, frozen online feature construction, head, and material packing; excludes physical acquisition and Native/Probit anchor construction.
Provider only includes full four-channel moment representation and K32 parent-local RNG/decoding; excludes feature construction and risk head.
Process peak RSS is cumulative across the harness, not an isolated per-arm allocation peak.

Historical teacher generation and all training costs remain read-only separate sunk-cost records. Full physics and end-to-end aggregated parent runtime must be reported separately from these inference timings.
All arms use identical first parent or first64 parents, observations, residuals, q0, chi0, J, and parent IDs. New raw-context loading materializes only allowed online fields.
Optimized K32 exact CPU prediction equivalence to unoptimized historical sampling and 2e-6 stored-moment gate are already recorded in CHECKPOINT_REPRODUCTION.json.
